name: git-wiki
description: A git-backed wiki system (monorepo: client + server + shared contracts).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server -c blue,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @wiki/contracts && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wiki/contracts && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
